documents.title: Query Product List
documents.description: query product by model number or sku code, may return multiple records

request.name: page_index
request.description: Paging parameter, specifies the page of the current query

request.name: page_size
request.description: Pagination parameter, specify the number of pages to be displayed per page, the maximum limit is 20. If the number of products that meet the query conditions is greater than 20, you need to set page_index to continue querying the second page, the third page, and so on

children.name: status
children.description: The status of the product. Currently there are 3 enumeration values:  online: The product has been approved and successfully released online, and users can see and purchase it (if inventory allows) offline: The product has been manually removed from the shelves and is not visible or available for purchase by users. deleted: The product has been deleted and is no longer visible on the entire platform.

children.name: audit_status
children.description: All products on alibaba.com are subject to risk control and compliance review. The optional values are:  approved: The product information has passed the review and can be online.  pending: The product information has been submitted and is waiting for review by the administrator or system. It has not yet been released.  rejected: The product information has not passed the review and needs to be modified and resubmitted.

documents.title: Edit Product Price
documents.description:

Update price information for either the SPU or SKU level. When only SKU price info is provided. Update the price for specified SKUs. When only price is provided: update price at SPU level.

documents.title: Edit Product Inventory
documents.description:
Updates inventory information for either the SPU or SKU  level.
    When SKU inventory info is provided: Updates inventory for specified SKUs (takes priority).
    When only inventory is provided: Updates inventory at the SPU level.
Cannot process SPU and SKU inventory simultaneously.

request.name: sku_inventory
request.description: SKU Inventory represents the real-time stock levels of a product variant, formatted as key-value pairs: Key (SKU ID) is unique identifier of the product variant. Value is new stock quantity to set for this SKU (Long, must be ≥ 0). Inventory and sku_inventory cannot be all null.  Example: {"12345": 100, "12346": 50} // Which means SKU ID:12345 has 100 units in stock now, SKU ID:12346 has 50 units in stock now.
